about.title: About us
about.label: about us
about.heroTitle: We design and build environments people are glad to live in.
about.heroText: Chawni is an architecture, engineering, interior and construction practice working across Bangladesh.
about.photoAlt: The Chawni team together in the studio (placeholder)
about.storyTitle: Started with one drawing table and a belief in honest buildings.
about.storyP1: Placeholder story. Chawni began as a small studio that wanted architecture and construction to stop blaming each other. Bringing both under one roof meant drawings that could be built and builders who understood the drawings.
about.storyP2: Today the practice spans residential, commercial, hospitality and institutional work. The principle is unchanged: plan carefully, design with care, engineer properly and build as drawn.
about.missionText: To deliver well-designed, soundly engineered and honestly built environments, on time and with respect for the people who use them.
about.visionText: To be the practice that clients trust first for buildings that last and communities that thrive.
